text_block_list.text:
"On my way back from an outing, I spotted some idol girls
holding a small-scale event."

text_block_list.name: Female Idol
text_block_list.text:
"Come on over to the 'Fruit Star' meet-and-greet!
Everyone's welcome to join in~!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer. Mind if I go take care of something real quick?"
choice_data_list: Hm? Got a favorite you're rooting for or something?
Hm? Do you have a favorite you're cheering for?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No, um... Is it called fan service?
I just wanted to study up on that sort of thing...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A handshake event... I've done one before too.
Back then, Earth-san and Gentil-san
really hyped up the crowd—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
It really hammered home how far I still have to go.
That's why I wanna learn! All about fan service!
choice_data_list: I see... Well then, go get 'em!

text_block_list.name: Female Idol
text_block_list.text:
Hello! Whoa, an Umamusume!
It's our first time meeting, right? What's your name?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm Win Variation.
Nice to meet you.

text_block_list.name: Female Idol
text_block_list.text:
Huh, variation? Like the ballet term, right?
I know it! I dabbled in ballet a bit back in the day!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really?! Me too!
My parents actually run a ballet studio—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: "...As expected of a pro, you're amazing. You're so good at keeping the conversation going..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer!
I wanna try out what I learned...
Mind lending me a hand?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for coming to the handshake event!
Let's chat a whole bunch!
choice_data_list: I'm always cheering for you! Seriously, I'm a huge fan!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Thanks a lot! I'm really happy
you're cheering for me! ...Yes, truly grateful!
choice_data_list: Your running gives me energy every single day, Shion-san!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
T-Thanks! Hearing you say that...
...Yes! I'm the one who got energized!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
......
That sounded like it meant something, but it actually meant nothing at all!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... No good...
I gotta put more thought into my fan service...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, one more time!
Mind joining me again?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I see, so my fans have... that kind of taste... Yeah, that's really interesting!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I don't really have hobbies... though I guess
I still watch videos of things like ballet.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"That's about all I've got.
So... yeah. Good luck with your hobby!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Aah, jeez!
Couldn't you have said something a little nicer... !

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Sigh. I'm sorry...
Even though you're taking the time for me, Trainer..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
…………Um. If it's a problem, totally,
you can turn me down, but……

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Just a little more... Can I give it
one more shot...?
choice_data_list: Today, we'll keep at it until you're satisfied!
Today, we'll keep at it until you're satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm so sorry...
Thank you so much...!

There was no need for her to apologize. I understood
why she was trying so hard, and above all—
choice_data_list: It's admirable that you refuse to give up.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm just a sore loser, is all. I'm not very quick on the uptake, so I gotta make up for it with hard work...
choice_data_list: It's admirable that you never give up on your ideal self!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
.............
Th-Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, that's true. If you say so,
Trainer... Yeah!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna try pushing myself just a little more!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I see! You're cheering for Shion so much,
Trainer-kun! That makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I see! You're cheering for Shion so much,
Trainer-chan! That makes me so happy!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ......Um, was this okay?
choice_data_list: ...I might be losing my character completely!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Damn it all!
One more time! Please, let's go again!
choice_data_list: There's a curfew and all, so we should probably call it a day...!
You'll be able to do it eventually, so there's no need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
choice_data_list: You really look like you don't want to do this...!
You really look like you don't want to do this, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... I'm sorry.
You're totally right, Trainer, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... After all, I can't go making
Cheval-san and Fuji-san worry about me..."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. For today, I'll head home for now.
And then, tomorrow—I'll do my best again!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
I guess so... Yeah.
Maybe I really am rushing it...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"...Understood!
I'll call it a day for today, ssu."

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...If you have time again sometime,
would you mind hanging out with me?
